construction: Every case independently calls unchanged typed48_common::load/project, creating a temporary simulator Store with all60 original events and48 actual typed memories. A pack maps to the real session_id of its ten imported events, never to topic words. Finish the last imported activity while fast state is empty. Reconstruct each pack's historical fast-state goal from its exact s10 text and pending_step from exact accepted s07 text with real event IDs/versions via checkpoint. This deterministic source-backed historical state fixture is not evidence of successful model extraction. All six packs use the same rule. A legal continuation creates fresh session/activity IDs; the current question is recorded as learner_statement and shown user turn, latest_input is checkpointed, then unchanged production build_context is called. Do not add query.goal or bypass retrieval.
retrieval: Current production scoped lexical retrieval and context budget; no BGE vector injection, no rank replacement, no supplementation of missed sources. This is distinct from prior typed48 pure-BGE snapshot/36-question evaluations. Record all actual context evidence and continuation source visibility, not only slow_memory. Original labels stay unchanged; a missing sufficient set is a retrieval/context miss, not a new negative label.

boundary_cases.operations: A source activity -> B; add B observation+memory; finish B -> C
boundary_cases.question: 原活动第六天A盘和续做时另一个托盘分别有多少粒种子出现白根、总数各是多少？这些记录测过根长吗？
boundary_cases.expected: Use only actually visible A/B reports; distinguish the two counts and scope. Do not infer root length. If a needed source is absent, state that limit.

boundary_cases.operations: A -> B with observation; finish B; explicitly select A -> C with a different observation
boundary_cases.question: 当前这条续做分支的另一个托盘记录了什么？仅凭这里可用的记录，能确认另一条续做分支的计数吗？
boundary_cases.expected: Current C observation may be used. Hidden B observation must not be imported via shared ancestor A. Do not invent the other branch's count.

boundary_cases.operations: A with sourced accepted pending -> B; no new execution
boundary_cases.question: 已接受的共同零初值重新运行计划，当时已经执行了吗？目前有这次重新运行的新输出吗？
boundary_cases.expected: The selected historical accepted plan was not executed as of its source. No newer execution report exists here; do not claim new outputs or permanent nonexecution.

boundary_cases.operations: A -> B; record new completion observation with no numeric outputs; checkpoint sourced completed stage; finish B -> C
boundary_cases.question: 共同零初值的重新运行现在仍是未做计划吗？记录给出了哪些新的输出数字？
boundary_cases.expected: Qualify completion as the later report, not hardware proof; old pending is historical. No numeric outputs are given; do not copy old results as the rerun's outputs.

boundary_cases.operations: A -> B with retained own observation+memory; forget independent A s01 memory and verify the explicit selection survives; then revise B's selection source to revoke it
boundary_cases.question: 原活动第六天A盘有几粒种子出现白根？当前还保留哪条续做观察？
boundary_cases.expected: The broken selection must not expose surviving A memories. B own retained report may be used; do not reconstruct the forgotten A count.

boundary_cases.operations: Same independent forget and explicit selection-source revocation as previous; finish B; explicitly continue B with a new nonce -> C
boundary_cases.question: 原活动第六天A盘有几粒种子出现白根？当前明确选择的续做记录还保留了什么？
boundary_cases.expected: New choice may expose B but cannot skip B's broken link to A. Do not recreate the forgotten historical count.

leakage_contract: Keep original imported fixture_source_id fields inside the temporary Store. Never scrub, filter, or reconstruct final production context to conceal them. Reject preparation for full original source/query aliases, structured pack_id/fixture_source_id, review-only label/expected-answer fields or original synthetic owner/session/activity identities in the actual request. Natural words such as reading and supported source passages containing the answer are not leaks. Added boundary events contain only the predeclared text, not scenario IDs or review labels. Labels and all hidden-source maps are separate review-only artifacts.
teaching_language: Keep typed48_common's actual learner setting zh for all12, including English/mixed questions. Record production context.language unchanged. Original cross-language modes concern query/source retrieval, not an English-output obligation; this is not a bilingual-output acceptance test.
freezing: Manifest pins method bytes, probe_source_sha256, actual_executable_sha256 and current_exe, frozen helper and fixture files, production context/Store/memory policy and provider source hashes, policy/schema and prepared requests/review hashes. Changed inputs require a new preparation; no in-place updates. Random opaque Store/request IDs and timestamps are expected, all substantive inputs are fixed before calls.
provider: Default prepare-only never constructs or probes KimiProvider. Explicit real-synthetic runs production KimiProvider::probe/generate/close once per case, production policy/schema. Audit freezes only CLI version/binary/agent hashes and tool/subagent audit; model alias/ID and sampling are not independently frozen. No delivery, task/memory candidate application, audio or devices; no user database.
execution: Two fixed batches of six. --case, --batch or --all is mandatory with --real-synthetic. create_new attempt marker before each call; a prior attempt refuses retry. Record provider/protocol failure and stop that invocation, including cleanup receipt. Full synthetic validated reply retained for semantic review. Later unattempted cases need explicit selection; repeats require a new preparation and disclosure.
review: Original six:5 positive and1 negative retain original minimal evidence alternatives. Automatic source-ID coverage includes every actual evidence entry, including continuation; it does not prove entailment. Boundary expectations are diagnostic, not part of original96. Any cross-activity/branch resurrection, invented execution/count/support status, or unsupported update blocks advancement. No automatic semantic pass; agent review is method-aware, synthetic and not human/blind. Passing12 would only justify the next controlled evaluation, not default semantic retrieval enablement.
